title: RPG story generators with voice, image generator, consistent characters, lots of freedom.
author: mizerr
selftext:
I came across this story/rpg generator via a reddit ad: [https://app.dreammir.ai/](https://app.dreammir.ai/)

And it's a big leap from last ones I tried because it has so many elements tied together. Still leaves plenty to be desired (like inventory for example) but cool to see progress.

Are there many other options like this? I know there are text-based prompts and basic story generation, but I haven't seen many with voice and narration and all that.

comments.author: verbalbacklash
comments.body: I just made mine available for free with bring your own key . It's got some of the same ideas. There are a good many out there some at like [https://altworld.io/](https://altworld.io/) and  [www.livethroughtime.com](http://www.livethroughtime.com/) have some great persistent worlds. Mine is [https://wordforgechronicles.com/](https://wordforgechronicles.com/) if you want to check it out. I use standard browser TTS for mine most of them are a bit robotic but the Male UK voice is pretty good for playing.

comments.author: nefD
comments.body: Frankly there are dozens of more sophisticated options, practically a new one every day. Are you affiliated with Dreammir or have you just not looked around?

replies.author: mizerr
replies.body: I've looked around, I don't see the more sophisticated options. im not affiliated with any.

replies.author: nefD
replies.body: I'm not going to do free advertising for commercial projects so instead I'll just point at SillyTavern and Aventuras. You can run them locally, providing your own API key, and they already provide way more functionality than Dreammir. And you can just get a nano sub for like $8 a month for about 60M tokens. These thin wrappers around LLM's are a dime a dozen and most of them are a terrible value.

replies.author: mizerr
replies.body: I dont know how to set those up for a good experience. They remember all charactesr and do voice and everything? Is itj ust plug and play or is there dev work to be done?

comments.author: Lazy_Firefighter5353
comments.body: Very cool concept. I like it. Would you be able to share it to [vibecodinglist.com](http://vibecodinglist.com) so other users can also give feedback?
